note: Quests now track real progress instead of a yes-or-no flag: every quest step counts on its own meter, and the log shows the count as you go — slay rats and it reads "Rats slain: 3/5", gather silk and it reads "Spider silk collected: 4/6". Work you do before picking a quest up counts too: rats you already killed are already on the meter when you accept, and a step you finished early waits for you instead of making you redo it. Old saves carry over untouched — a finished quest stays finished, and half-finished progress stays exactly where you left it.
